subject: Demo — Aligning VP/CTO attendance and backup coverage
messages:
From: Carla Diaz <carla@acme.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Jan 20 demo — CTO travel conflict

Hi Mina,

Quick heads up — the demo we have scheduled for Jan 20 at 10:00 PT is complicated on our side. Our CTO (Frank Lee) has an unavoidable transit window that day and likely won't be able to join the first half of the session. He asked if we can either push the meeting to Jan 21 or have a plan where the VP (Sara Kline) leads the executive intro and Frank hops on for the technical/closing portion if his travel allows.

We really want Frank to see the technical deep-dive, but we also have a hard deadline to make a decision that week. Can you advise whether Redwood can (a) shift to Jan 21, or (b) keep Jan 20 with backup coverage and a clear handoff so Frank can join late? Also, can you confirm who on your side would cover the architecture walkthrough if Frank isn't on the call?

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply.

— Carla
Carla Diaz
Director, Strategic Ops
Acme Co.
carla@acme.co

P.S. Attaching our internal calendar note for the conflict (sent separately via salesops).

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Carla Diaz <carla@acme.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 09:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Jan 20 demo — CTO travel conflict

Thanks for the note, Carla — and appreciate the heads up. We can do either option; my recommendation is to keep Jan 20 and put a clear "handoff & standby" plan in place so Frank can join the later portion without us losing momentum. That keeps your decision timeline intact and minimizes rework for both teams.

Proposed checklist:
- Jonas (VP) will join the first 10 minutes for executive framing and customer success alignment.
- Karthik will lead the architecture and technical deep-dive (30–35 minutes).
- Reserve the last 15 minutes for Frank to join for live Q&A and closing remarks (we'll plan for him to join late).
- We'll include a 5-minute buffer for travel/connection delay.

If Frank confirms he cannot join at all, Jonas can close and we will record the technical appendix for a short follow-up session with Frank next week.

I've attached a quick handover checklist and a draft invite with both time options (Jan 20 10:00 PT / Jan 21 10:00 PT) so you can pick. Can you confirm which you prefer by EOD? Karthik — can you confirm you can cover the technical deep-dive and prep the appendix slides?

Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: handover-checklist.txt, acme-demo-invite-ics.ics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Carla Diaz <carla@acme.co>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Jan 20 demo — CTO travel conflict

I'm on it — I can cover the architecture walkthrough and will compress the technical content into a focused 30–35 minute segment with an appendix ready in case Frank can only join for the final Q&A. I will: 
- Prepare a 10-slide appendix that walks through inference runtime, quantization options, and routing/fallback behavior.
- Add a short runbook for the handoff (who says what when Frank joins).
- Share the appendix as "demo-technical-appendix.pdf" before the call.

Agenda (compressed):
1) Exec intro (Jonas) — 10 min
2) Technical walkthrough (Karthik) — 30–35 min
3) Live demo & Q&A — 15–20 min (Frank joins if possible)

If you want, we can also set a standing phone number for Frank to jump on if Meet proves flaky during travel. Mina — I'll upload the appendix and runbook by EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: demo-technical-appendix.pdf

From: Carla Diaz <carla@acme.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, acme-salesops@acme.co
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 16:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Jan 20 demo — CTO travel conflict

Perfect — thanks, everyone. We prefer to keep Jan 20 (10:00 PT) and proceed with the standby/coverage plan you outlined. Frank will try to join for the last 15 minutes — we'll forward any calendar conflicts from SalesOps if his travel changes. Please send the confirmed calendar invite with the Meet link and include the appendix so our senior engineers can pre-read.

Mina — please go ahead and finalize the invite for Jan 20 10:00 PT and we'll route any last-minute changes through acme-salesops@acme.co. Appreciate the rapid coordination.

Best,
Carla

---
